flags.en: Supply crates required for Enhanced primary production (default 16)
flags.tr: Caixes de subministrament necessàries per a la producció primària millorada (per defecte, 16)

flags.en: Supply crates required for Gung-ho primary production (default 80)
flags.tr: Caixes de subministrament necessàries per a la producció primària Gung-ho (per defecte, 80)

flags.en: Farms, mines and similar industries will increase production when supply crates are delivered, first to {SILVER}Enhanced{BLACK}, and then to {SILVER}Gung-ho{BLACK}, if enough crates are delivered.  {}{}The default values are good, but if you need to, you can change them here.  {}{}Cargo requirements for port-type industries will be 8x the values set here.
flags.tr: Les granges, les mines i les indústries similars augmentaran la producció quan s'entreguin caixes de subministrament, primer a {SILVER}Enhanced{BLACK} i després a {SILVER}Gung-ho{BLACK}, si s'entreguen prou caixes.  {}{}Els valors predeterminats són adequats, però, si cal, els podeu canviar aquí.  {}{}Els requisits de càrrega per a les indústries de tipus port seran 8 vegades superiors als valors establerts aquí.

flags.en: Snow for buildings above snowline
flags.tr: Neu per als edificis per sobre de la línia de neu

flags.en: CIRS adjusts default town behaviour: towns above snowline do not require food to grow, and towns in desert do not require food and water to grow.
flags.tr: CIRS ajusta el comportament predeterminat de les ciutats: les ciutats per sobre de la línia de neu no necessiten menjar per créixer, i les ciutats al desert no necessiten menjar ni aigua per créixer.

flags.en: Economies can be used in any OpenTTD climate, but some are designed to work best in the temperate, sub-arctic or sub-tropic climates.
flags.tr: Les economies es poden fer servir en qualsevol clima d'OpenTTD, però algunes estan dissenyades per funcionar millor en els climes temperat, subàrtic o subtropical.

flags.tr: Markdown (analitzador del format de text Markdown)

flags.en: For cargo class names, FIRS 4 and newer uses FRAX, an improved standard for cargo classes.
flags.tr: Per als noms de classe de càrrega, FIRS 4 i posteriors usen FRAX, un estàndard millorat per a classes de càrrega.

flags.en: * Price Factor is a base value, will be automatically adjusted per economy to ensure no prices overlap.
flags.tr: * El factor de preu és un valor base, que s'ajustarà automàticament per economia per assegurar que els preus no es solapin.

flags.en: ** Town growth effects: apart from TOWNGROWTH_PASSENGERS and TOWNGROWTH_MAIL, CIRS does not set any town growth effects; this has the intended effect of disabling food / water requirements for towns in desert and above snowline.
flags.tr: ** Efectes de creixement de la ciutat: excepte TOWNGROWTH_PASSENGERS i TOWNGROWTH_MAIL, CIRS no defineix cap efecte de creixement de la ciutat; això té l'efecte previst de desactivar els requisits de menjar / aigua per a les ciutats al desert i per sobre de la línia de neu.

flags.en: Game text lives in src/grf/lang/*.toml (NewGRF strings) and src/gs/lang/*.toml (GameScript strings). Website text lives in src/docs/lang/*.toml and src/docs/extra_strings*.toml.

flags.en: Simple economy. Inspired by Argentina, Peru and Chile. Best used with Sub-Tropic climate.
flags.tr: Economia senzilla. Inspirada per l'Argentina, el Perú i Xile. Es recomana utilitzar-la amb un clima subtropical.

flags.en: Generic clays, for producing building materials and other industrial uses.
flags.tr: Argiles genèriques, per produir materials de construcció i per a altres usos industrials.

flags.en: Chemicals, soaps, scouring agents etc for industrial and domestic use. Primarily liquid, can also be powder or solid (such as shot blasting sand).
flags.tr: Productes químics, sabons, agents abrasius, etc., per a ús industrial i domèstic. Principalment líquids, però també poden ser en pols o sòlids (com ara sorra per a sablatge).

flags.en: Oil for cooking and consumption.
flags.tr: Oli per cuinar i per al consum.

flags.en: Coarse sand for construction, or fine silica sand for glass-making and metal casting. Transported as bulk or powder.
flags.tr: Sorra gruixuda per a la construcció, o sorra fina de silici per a fabricar vidre i fer fosa de metalls. Es transporta a granel o en pols.

flags.en: Thin steel sheet coated with tin for corrosion resistance, used mainly for cans, containers and other packaging.
flags.tr: Fulla d’acer fina recoberta d’estany per resistir la corrosió, utilitzada principalment per fabricar llaunes, contenidors i altres embalatges.

flags.en: For cargo class names, FIRS 4 and newer uses FRAX, an improved standard for cargo classes.
flags.tr: For godsklassenavne bruger FIRS 4 og nyere FRAX, en forbedret standard for gods klasser.

flags.en: FRAX classes are the preferred method for vehicle refittability support. There are some detailed cases where authors may find it helpful to set vehicle refittability using cargo labels instead.
flags.tr: FRAX-klasser er den foretrukne metode til understøttelse af køretøjsomstilling. Der er nogle detaljerede tilfælde, hvor det kan være nyttigt for forfattere at definere omstilling via gods-etiketter i stedet.

flags.en: ** Town growth effects: apart from TOWNGROWTH_PASSENGERS and TOWNGROWTH_MAIL, CIRS does not set any town growth effects; this has the intended effect of disabling food / water requirements for towns in desert and above snowline.
flags.tr: ** Byvæksteffekter: med undtagelse af TOWNGROWTH_PASSENGERS og TOWNGROWTH_MAIL angiver CIRS ingen byvæksteffekter; dette har den tilsigtede effekt at deaktivere mad-/vandkravene for byer i ørkenen og over snegrænsen.

Féiert dann tools/check_translations.py aus fir ze verifizéieren datt d'Schlësselen a Plazhalter mat der englescher Quell iwwerene stëmmen.

flags.en: Snow for buildings above snowline
flags.tr: Snø for bygninger over snøgrensen

flags.en: CIRS adjusts default town behaviour: towns above snowline do not require food to grow, and towns in desert do not require food and water to grow.
flags.tr: CIRS justerer standardbyenes oppførsel: byer over snøgrensen trenger ikke mat for å vokse, og byer i ørkenen trenger verken mat eller vann for å vokse.

flags.en: CIRS source includes a makefile for convenient building. This requires 'Make', typically provided by the ports tree on Linux / Unix, Xcode on macOS, and other build systems on Windows.
flags.tr: CIRS-kildekoden inkluderer en makefile for enkel bygging. Dette krever 'Make', som vanligvis leveres via portstreet på Linux/Unix, Xcode på macOS og andre byggesystemer på Windows.

flags.en: For cargo class names, FIRS 4 and newer uses FRAX, an improved standard for cargo classes.
flags.tr: For vareklassenavn bruker FIRS 4 og nyere FRAX, en forbedret standard for vareklasser.

flags.en: FRAX classes are the preferred method for vehicle refittability support. There are some detailed cases where authors may find it helpful to set vehicle refittability using cargo labels instead.
flags.tr: FRAX-klasser er den foretrukne metoden for støtte av kjøretøyomstilling. Det finnes noen detaljerte tilfeller der det kan være nyttig for forfattere å definere omstilling via vareetiketter i stedet.

flags.en: * Price Factor is a base value, will be automatically adjusted per economy to ensure no prices overlap.
flags.tr: * Prisfaktoren er en grunnverdi som automatisk justeres per økonomi for å sikre at priser ikke overlapper.

flags.en: ** Town growth effects: apart from TOWNGROWTH_PASSENGERS and TOWNGROWTH_MAIL, CIRS does not set any town growth effects; this has the intended effect of disabling food / water requirements for towns in desert and above snowline.
flags.tr: ** Byveksteffekter: med unntak av TOWNGROWTH_PASSENGERS og TOWNGROWTH_MAIL angir CIRS ingen byveksteffekter; dette har den tiltenkte effekten å deaktivere mat-/vannkravene for byer i ørkenen og over snøgrensen.

targeted.en: The full FIRS git history is preserved, so future upstream changes can be merged instead of forked away.
targeted.tr: Pełna historia git FIRS jest zachowywana, dzięki czemu przyszłe zmiany z upstream mogą być scalane zamiast być rozwidlane.
